{{Quote|Several hours ago, small shuttles built to avoid sensor detection began to land and deliver troops to the planet's surface. These troops are brutal alien mercenaries of the exiled Lord Tytonus. Students of Sith politics will remember she was the rebel who declared her own kingdom on Begeren.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Shellaster (major)|Shellaster]]|<ref name="TOR:FoO" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tytonus]] instigated a '''revolution''' against the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and the [[Dark Council]]. After declaring her own [[Tytonus's kingdom|kingdom]] on [[Begeren]], Tytonus was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but maintained power through an extensive [[Tytonus's mercenary army|mercenary army]]. The Sith [[Queen/Legends|queen's]] revolution came to an end around [[3643 BBY]] when she entered into an alliance with another [[Grathan's revolt|rebelling]] Sith Lord&mdash;[[Grathan]]. Tytonus sought to aid Grathan on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] by landing her army on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and [[Assault on Kaas City|marching on]] the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Kaas City]]. During the attempt, Lord Tytonus was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an Imperial strike team.<ref name="TOR:FoO" />
